subject: Goalpost: Transfer timeline, owners, and technical escrow
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya.rao@goalposthealth.com>, Goalpost Procurement <procurement@goalposthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Goalpost: Transfer timeline, owners, and technical escrow

Team —

Quick handoff note now that we have a countersigned SOW (attached). Goalpost is expecting a formal kickoff in the week of 8/31 but they are flexible if we need to shift to the following week. High-level context and asks below so CS/implementation can scope and plan: 

- Deal: Goalpost Health (GP-4521) — Production inference for care-routing and summary generation.
- Signed ARR: $425k/year, 3x dedicated capacity nodes initially (forecast).
- Timeline: procurement finish by 8/24, kickoff week preference 8/31, target pilot acceptance 10/05.
- Primary customer contacts: Maya Rao (PM, product) and procurement@goalposthealth.com.

Top risks / constraints that matter for implementation: 
1) Security gating: they require evidence for SOC 2 + a short KMS/HSM integration note. They asked for proof of log retention and encryption-in-transit details by 8/25.
2) Data residency: primary region is us-west; they may request VPC private deployment for PHI-sensitive endpoints.
3) Model variant: they signed for "rwd-small-2026" quantized profile; engineering flagged a tokenization edge-case that could affect clinical notes — needs QA before pilot.
4) Throughput: expected steady-state of ~20 reqs/sec with burst to 60; plan staging capacity accordingly.

Attachments: Goalpost_SOW_v3.pdf (redline accepted). Also shared a security checklist we asked them to fill.

Requesting the following from CS/implementation:
- Assign a primary CSM and a technical lead we can introduce to Maya by EOD 8/22.
- Confirm sandbox credentialing window (we can provide temporary sandbox on 8/25-8/27).
- Estimate initial 30/60/90 staffing and a brief activation runbook (1 page) by 8/24.

I can join the kickoff on 8/31 for the intros if helpful.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Goalpost_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya.rao@goalposthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goalpost: Transfer timeline, owners, and technical escrow

Thanks Grace — good context. Assigning owners and initial asks below.

Owners (tentative):
- Primary CSM: Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai) — will lead kickoff and ongoing adoption.
- Technical Lead / Implementation Engineer: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — responsible for sandbox, integration, and performance tuning.
- Program Manager (ops): Karthik Iyer — single-threaded escalation and timeline owner.

Action items for CS/Eng (please confirm ETA):
1) Stephanie: Draft 1-page activation runbook covering objectives, success criteria, and acceptance gating (due 8/24).
2) Ben: Provision sandbox environment and share creds with Goalpost (ETA 8/25). Note: if they require VPC, estimate lead time is 2-3 weeks — flag immediately.
3) Stephanie/Ben: Kickoff meeting invite for week of 8/31 (propose Tue 8/31 10:00am PT).
4) Ben: Quick checklist on the quantization tokenization issue — include a short test plan for clinical notes.

A couple of clarifying questions for Grace / Maya:
- Grace, did procurement confirm any specific KMS provider (AWS KMS vs customer-managed HSM)?
- Maya, can you confirm the expected timing for the completed security checklist? You mentioned procurement completing paperwork this week.

I'll draw up an internal playbook and create OPS-4521 in Jira for tracking.

From: Maya Rao <maya.rao@goalposthealth.com>

Cc: procurement@goalposthealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goalpost: Transfer timeline, owners, and technical escrow

Grace / team —

Thanks for the clear handoff. Procurement will finish PO and signatures by EOD Monday 8/24; procurement@goalposthealth.com is on copy for any last questions. We will fill out the security-evidence-checklist.xlsx and have that returned to you by COB 8/24. For KMS: Goalpost prefers AWS KMS but we can sign a customer-managed KMS addendum if required — happy to discuss during kickoff.

A few notes from our side:
- We will need sandbox access with a service account and token rotation enabled.
- Staging dataset includes de-identified notes for the first 30 days, and a bigger ingestion for load tests (we can seed this starting 9/07).
- We prefer a kickoff on Tue 8/31 10:00am PT — the timing works for our product and security leads.

I'll send the completed security checklist and a procurement confirmation once both are signed. Looking forward to introductions.

Best,
Maya Rao
Product Manager | Goalpost Health
maya.rao@goalposthealth.com

Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya.rao@goalposthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goalpost: Transfer timeline, owners, and technical escrow

All — thanks. Confirming owners and next steps from the CS side after syncing with Ben: 

- Primary CSM: Stephanie Nguyen. Intro email to Maya scheduled after we finalize the kickoff invite.
- Tech lead: Ben Carter — provisioning planned for 8/25; if VPC is needed we will open a capacity request and flag procurement.
- Kickoff: Sending calendar invite for Tue 8/31 10:00am PT to all participants.
- Activation runbook: Drafted and attached (short runbook in Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink).
- Jira: OPS-4521 created for tracking; link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4521.

Sandbox creds: Ben will share a one-time token and service account by 8/25 morning. Ben, please attach the provisioning checklist to OPS-4521 when ready.

I'll also schedule a 30-minute prep with the product/security stakeholders on 8/28 to walk acceptance criteria and KMS options. Grace — if you'd like to join that prep, happy to have you.
